key: AYA: So...
en: AYA: So...
ja: アヤ: それで……

key: You're seeing this place too, right?
en: You're seeing this place too, right?
ja: あなたにも、ここが見えてるのよね?

key: I'm not just delusional?
en: I'm not just delusional?
ja: あたし、ただの妄想じゃないわよね?

key: That's always nice.
en: That's always nice.
ja: それはいつだって、ありがたいものね。

key: AYA: Hey, excuse me-- what?!
en: AYA: Hey, excuse me-- what?!
ja: アヤ: ちょっと、あの――何!?

key: KrrzzSCT
en: KrrzzSCT
ja: クルズズSCT

key: KrrxxxZCT
en: KrrxxxZCT
ja: クルクスクスZCT

key: AYA: ...What the hell was that?
en: AYA: ...What the hell was that?
ja: アヤ: ……今の、一体何?

key: AYA: ...Well, looks like there's only one way to go.
en: AYA: ...Well, looks like there's only one way to go.
ja: アヤ: ……まあ、進む道は一つしかないみたいね。

key: Hopefully everyone else is here too... somewhere.
en: Hopefully everyone else is here too... somewhere.
ja: みんなも、どこかにここにいてくれるといいけど……

key: AYA: This is a New World, isn't it?
en: AYA: This is a New World, isn't it?
ja: アヤ: ここって、ニューワールドよね?

key: Freshly created, blank slate existence?
en: Freshly created, blank slate existence?
ja: できたばかりの、まっさらな存在のはず?

key: So how is it that all this machinery even exists?
en: So how is it that all this machinery even exists?
ja: それなのに、どうしてこんな機械があるわけ?

key: I guess the only possible explanation is that it's being influenced by ours...
en: I guess the only possible explanation is that it's being influenced by ours...
ja: 考えられる説明は、こっちの世界に影響されてるってことくらいね……

key: ...Well, whatever.
en: ...Well, whatever.
ja: ……まあ、どうでもいいわ。

key: It makes these computer things easy to use at least.
en: It makes these computer things easy to use at least.
ja: おかげで、このコンピューターも扱いやすくはなってるし。

key: There's a toggle here...
en: There's a toggle here...
ja: ここにスイッチがある……

key: Let's see what happens.
en: Let's see what happens.
ja: どうなるか、見てみましょう。

key: AYA: Looks like this switch is linked to a handful of the doors in here.
en: AYA: Looks like this switch is linked to a handful of the doors in here.
ja: アヤ: このスイッチ、いくつかのドアと連動してるみたいね。

key: It might be the same for some of the other panels.
en: It might be the same for some of the other panels.
ja: 他のパネルも同じかもしれない。

key: For now, I'll see if there's anything ahead.
en: For now, I'll see if there's anything ahead.
ja: とりあえず、この先に何かあるか見てみるわ。

key: AYA: For like the third time in a row:
en: AYA: For like the third time in a row:
ja: アヤ: これで三回連続だけど――

key: What the hell?!
en: What the hell?!
ja: 一体何なのよ!?

key: Does someone wanna tell me what is happening here?!
en: Does someone wanna tell me what is happening here?!
ja: 誰か、ここで何が起きてるのか教えてくれない!?

key: Obviously not, so forget it--
en: Obviously not, so forget it--
ja: どうせ誰も教えてくれないんでしょうね、もういいわ――

key: These things are just going to keep spilling out if someone doesn't keep them in check...
en: These things are just going to keep spilling out if someone doesn't keep them in check...
ja: 誰かが抑えておかないと、こいつら際限なくあふれ出てくるだけだから……

key: So I'll just live with it like I always have.
en: So I'll just live with it like I always have.
ja: だから、いつも通りそれと付き合っていくしかないわね。

key: I'll keep them at bay while you look for the others, or some way to shut these guys down, or--
en: I'll keep them at bay while you look for the others, or some way to shut these guys down, or--
ja: あたしがこいつらを食い止めてる間に、あなたは他のみんなを探すか、こいつらを止める方法を探すか――

key: God, anything.
en: God, anything.
ja: とにかく、何でもいいから。

key: I'm counting on you, so please do something resembling hurrying!
en: I'm counting on you, so please do something resembling hurrying!
ja: あなたを頼りにしてるんだから、急いでる「っぽい」ことでもしてよね!

key: Dragalge, Lycanroc!
en: Dragalge, Lycanroc!
ja: ドラミドロ、ルガルガン!

key: AYA: We're in for the long haul here...
en: AYA: We're in for the long haul here...
ja: アヤ: ここは長丁場になりそうね……

key: So as a certain stupid boy says...
en: So as a certain stupid boy says...
ja: だから、どっかのバカな男の子の言葉を借りるなら……

key: Let's get ready to rock!
en: Let's get ready to rock!
ja: 準備はいいか、暴れるわよ!

key: AYA: I don't expect to beat them alone...
en: AYA: I don't expect to beat them alone...
ja: アヤ: 一人で全部倒せるとは思ってないけど……

key: But if I can hold their attention long enough for you to make something happen, that's good enough, right?
en: But if I can hold their attention long enough for you to make something happen, that's good enough, right?
ja: あなたが何とかするまで、こいつらの気を引きつけておければ、それで十分でしょ?

key: I'll stay here and endure it like I always have.
en: I'll stay here and endure it like I always have.
ja: あたしはここに残って、いつも通り耐えるから。

key: AYA: So the others are trapped here, huh?
en: AYA: So the others are trapped here, huh?
ja: アヤ: つまり、みんなここに閉じ込められてるってわけね?

key: Looks like I'm in for the long haul.
en: Looks like I'm in for the long haul.
ja: 長丁場になりそうね。

key: We're holding up, but I don't know for how long...
en: We're holding up, but I don't know for how long...
ja: なんとか持ちこたえてるけど、いつまで持つか分からないわ……

key: AYA: \PN, did you just change the temperature in here-- was that you?
en: AYA: \PN, did you just change the temperature in here-- was that you?
ja: アヤ: \PN、今この部屋の温度変えた……? あなたなの?

key: I have an idea.
en: I have an idea.
ja: いい考えがあるの。

key: See if you can find a way to make it hotter instead!
en: See if you can find a way to make it hotter instead!
ja: 代わりに、もっと熱くする方法がないか探してみて!

key: If we can overheat the whole facility, maybe I can wipe all these guys out at once!
en: If we can overheat the whole facility, maybe I can wipe all these guys out at once!
ja: 施設全体を過熱させられれば、こいつら全部まとめて一掃できるかもしれない!

key: Gotta get back to it-- move fast!
en: Gotta get back to it-- move fast!
ja: あたしも戻らなきゃ――急いで!

key: AYA: See if you can find a way to amp the temperature!
en: AYA: See if you can find a way to amp the temperature!
ja: アヤ: 温度を上げる方法がないか、探してみて!

key: If you can, I'll try to take them all out at once!
en: If you can, I'll try to take them all out at once!
ja: できたら、あたしが全部まとめて片付けてみせるから!

key: AYA: I did it!
en: AYA: I did it!
ja: アヤ: やったわ!

key: They're all fuckin' burning!
en: They're all fuckin' burning!
ja: 全部、クソほど燃えてる!

key: Every single one of them!
en: Every single one of them!
ja: 一匹残らずね!

key: Hahahaha-- take that, motherfuckers!
en: Hahahaha-- take that, motherfuckers!
ja: はっはっは――ざまあみろ、クソ野郎ども!

key: WOOO!!
en: WOOO!!
ja: うおおおおっ!!

key: AYA: ...Okay, that's a break.
en: AYA: ...Okay, that's a break.
ja: アヤ: ……よし、一区切りね。

key: AYA: Man, is this how Charlotte feels all the time?
en: AYA: Man, is this how Charlotte feels all the time?
ja: アヤ: はぁ、シャルロットっていつもこんな気分なわけ?

key: Maybe I should jump types.
en: Maybe I should jump types.
ja: タイプ変えた方がいいのかも。

key: "EMERGENCY ACCESS ONLY-- DISABLED EXCEPT IN CASE OF FIRE."
en: "EMERGENCY ACCESS ONLY-- DISABLED EXCEPT IN CASE OF FIRE."
ja: 「緊急時専用アクセス――火災時以外は使用不可」

key: "SHUTTER SYSTEM-- MODE B"
en: "SHUTTER SYSTEM-- MODE B"
ja: 「シャッターシステム――モードB」

key: "SHUTTER SYSTEM-- MODE A"
en: "SHUTTER SYSTEM-- MODE A"
ja: 「シャッターシステム――モードA」

key: Activate?
en: Activate?
ja: 起動しますか?

key: ISO-SHUTTER UNLOCKED
en: ISO-SHUTTER UNLOCKED
ja: アイソシャッター、解除完了

key: ARC: \PN! You're sure a sight for a sore eye!
en: ARC: \PN! You're sure a sight for a sore eye!
ja: アーク: \PN! お前の顔、拝めてありがたいぜ!

key: And just in the nick of time.
en: And just in the nick of time.
ja: しかもドンピシャのタイミングだ。

key: These two gizmos just galloped out of the woodwork.
en: These two gizmos just galloped out of the woodwork.
ja: こいつらのガラクタ、どこからともなく飛び出してきやがってな。

key: Wanna put the rust on 'em with me?
en: Wanna put the rust on 'em with me?
ja: 一緒にさびつかせてやらないか?

key: ARC: Nice work.
en: ARC: Nice work.
ja: アーク: いい仕事だ。

key: That might've been some rough stuff if you hadn't showed up when you did.
en: That might've been some rough stuff if you hadn't showed up when you did.
ja: お前が来てなかったら、ちょっとヤバいことになってたかもな。

key: ARC: And it looks like one of them dropped something.
en: ARC: And it looks like one of them dropped something.
ja: アーク: それに、片方が何か落としていったみたいだな。

key: ARC: I don't suppose you know what this is, do you?
en: ARC: I don't suppose you know what this is, do you?
ja: アーク: これが何なのか、お前は分かるか?

key: ARC: All yours either way.
en: ARC: All yours either way.
ja: アーク: まあどっちにしろ、お前にやるよ。

key: Now for the rewind:
en: Now for the rewind:
ja: さて、ここまでの経緯だが。

key: We were in the atrium trying to stitch up the sitch when we started getting some funk on the line.
en: We were in the atrium trying to stitch up the sitch when we started getting some funk on the line.
ja: アトリウムで状況を立て直そうとしてたら、回線がおかしくなり始めてな。

key: Blinked and we were here, tapped our heels and we weren't.
en: Blinked and we were here, tapped our heels and we weren't.
ja: まばたきしたらここにいて、かかとを鳴らしたらいなくなって。

key: Came and went a few times in the confusion and eventually we went with it.
en: Came and went a few times in the confusion and eventually we went with it.
ja: 混乱の中で何度か行ったり来たりして、結局そのまま流されることにした。

key: I think this is a New World sector that's overlapped with the real world.
en: I think this is a New World sector that's overlapped with the real world.
ja: ここはたぶん、現実世界と重なったニューワールドの区画だ。

key: We had a few of those before you drifted back into existence and it wasn't pretty.
en: We had a few of those before you drifted back into existence and it wasn't pretty.
ja: お前が存在に戻る前にも、そういうのが何回かあったが、あんまりいい光景じゃなかったぞ。

key: Once we clear out all the Anomalies it should be safe, but in the meantime I'm not the only one stuck in here.
en: Once we clear out all the Anomalies it should be safe, but in the meantime I'm not the only one stuck in here.
ja: アノマリーを全部片付けりゃ安全になるはずだが、それまではここに閉じ込められてるのは俺だけじゃない。

key: I saw some of the shelter residents stuck a little further in, so I'm gonna head forward and free them first.
en: I saw some of the shelter residents stuck a little further in, so I'm gonna head forward and free them first.
ja: シェルターの住民が少し奥に閉じ込められてるのを見たから、先に助けに行ってくる。

key: I'm counting on you to keep the rest of the set safe.
en: I'm counting on you to keep the rest of the set safe.
ja: 残りの安全は、お前に任せたぞ。

key: I'll check in when I can. Stay tuned.
en: I'll check in when I can. Stay tuned.
ja: また連絡できるときに連絡する。それまで待っててくれ。

en: "SYSTEM COOLING OFFLINE."
ja: 「システム冷却、オフライン」

key: CAIN: Heyyy, \PN, nice timing as always!
en: CAIN: Heyyy, \PN, nice timing as always!
ja: カイン: よぉ、\PN、相変わらずいいタイミングだな!

key: These two just showed up and were starting to get a little rough for my taste.
en: These two just showed up and were starting to get a little rough for my taste.
ja: こいつら二匹、突然現れてさ、ちょっとオレの好みじゃないくらい手荒になってきたところだ。

key: Wanna double dip with me?
en: Wanna double dip with me?
ja: 一緒に相手してくれるか?

key: CAIN: So... what is that, like...
en: CAIN: So... what is that, like...
ja: カイン: それで……これって、なんだ、その……

key: The fourth... fifth time you've saved me?
en: The fourth... fifth time you've saved me?
ja: 4回目……いや5回目の「助けられた」ってやつか?

key: Just so you know, I don't try to be a damsel or anything,
en: Just so you know, I don't try to be a damsel or anything,
ja: 一応言っとくけど、別に「か弱い姫」を気取ってるわけじゃないぜ、

key: I'm just naturally good at it~
en: I'm just naturally good at it~
ja: ただ生まれつき、そういうのが得意なだけでさ～

key: CAIN: And they left a souvenir.
en: CAIN: And they left a souvenir.
ja: カイン: それと、お土産を置いてったな。

key: CAIN: My prize to you, my savior~
en: CAIN: My prize to you, my savior~
ja: カイン: これはオレの命の恩人へのご褒美ってことで～

key: CAIN: I saw my mom further in.
en: CAIN: I saw my mom further in.
ja: カイン: この先に、オレの母さんが見えたんだ。

key: She was... a big part of the reason I left.
en: She was... a big part of the reason I left.
ja: あの人が……オレが家を出た大きな理由の一つでさ。

key: But even so, I can't just abandon her here.
en: But even so, I can't just abandon her here.
ja: それでも、ここに置き去りにするわけにはいかない。

key: Even if she is totally out of line, I'm gonna go get her out.
en: Even if she is totally out of line, I'm gonna go get her out.
ja: どれだけ理不尽な人だったとしても、助けに行ってくるよ。

key: Who knows, maybe she'll figure out how to treat me like a reasonable human being somewhere along the way.
en: Who knows, maybe she'll figure out how to treat me like a reasonable human being somewhere along the way.
ja: もしかしたら、その途中でオレをまともな人間として扱う方法くらい、見つけてくれるかもな。

key: I'll see you soon! Ta!
en: I'll see you soon! Ta!
ja: またすぐ会おう! じゃあな!

key: TITANIA: I assume you already know what's going on here.
en: TITANIA: I assume you already know what's going on here.
ja: ティタニア: ここで何が起きてるか、もう分かってるんでしょうね。

key: Fight first; chat later.
en: Fight first; chat later.
ja: 戦うのが先、話すのは後よ。

key: TITANIA: Hardy is going to owe me like, infinity favors after this.
en: TITANIA: Hardy is going to owe me like, infinity favors after this.
ja: ティタニア: ハーディには、これで無限に借りを作らせてやるわ。

key: TITANIA: This is all yours.
en: TITANIA: This is all yours.
ja: ティタニア: これは全部あんたのものよ。

key: TITANIA: When we were dragged over into this space, I caught a glimpse of where Tez was isolated.
en: TITANIA: When we were dragged over into this space, I caught a glimpse of where Tez was isolated.
ja: ティタニア: この空間に引きずり込まれたとき、テズが隔離されてる場所をちらっと見たの。

key: Loathe as I am for it, I'm going to spare the others the burden of rescuing him.
en: Loathe as I am for it, I'm going to spare the others the burden of rescuing him.
ja: 気が進まないけど、他のみんなにあいつを助ける重荷を背負わせるのは、あたしがやめさせるわ。

key: Better I do it than they have to,
en: Better I do it than they have to,
ja: みんながやるくらいなら、あたしがやった方がマシだし、

key: And I have some more choice words for him.
en: And I have some more choice words for him.
